scope: workflow feature contracts and owned macOS integrations, not autonomous business benchmark

cases.goal: Window movement and changed refs preserve semantic target
Closed app starts at its exact installed identity and binds a new PID
Ambiguous target causes zero input
Capture selected app value edits without dispatching again
Pause terminates input tap; resume preserves pause boundary
Unknown completion never redispatches
Crash after dispatch resumes using cached operation
Approval after stale observation requires a fresh exact approval
Reject unauthorized executable, modified grant and selector overrides
Desktop headless uses background native APIs with no foreground/pointer fallback
Browser and code workflows run in both modes
CLI, Studio, SDK and MCP share Runtime and durable operations
Version editing, conflict checks, history and archive
Authenticated local UX CRUD and cross-origin rejection
cases.live: Studio recording draft, v1/v2 and replay

cases.goal: Cancellation denies pending approval and prevents resume
Concurrent resume dispatches once
Refresh known-zero stale request and finish under pregrant
Real generated OS pointer/keyboard events record and replay
Actual human mouse and keyboard capture -> saved workflow -> replay
cases.requires: user participation and unobstructed normal input desktop

cases.goal: Windows manual input listener, native replay and Studio acceptance
